title: Layout
description: A hand-drawn lane plan a Battlefield is remixed from: where the base, Landing Zones, lanes, pads, building sites and features go, and the water, rock, high ground and cover round them. Every point is a share of the map's width and height, drawn with the attacker's edge at the top (y 0) and the defender's at the bottom (y 1).

point.description: [x, y]: shares of the map's width and height, 0 to 1.

replace.description: Replace an existing definition with this id.

name.description: What the Lab and editors call it.

archetypes.description: The Battlefield Archetypes it suits; left out, any.

presets.description: The Terrain Presets it suits; left out, any.

weight.description: How often it's picked among those that suit, against the others' weights. Defaults to 1.

mirror.description: Whether generation may flip it left to right.

base.description: Where the base fixture goes: its middle.

attacker.description: An attacker can land at it, and holds it from the start.

lanes.description: Routes units travel, each a line through its points; cleared where a ground Unit Class couldn't cross.

areas.description: Shapes of ground: water (the preset's lowest band), blocked (its top band: cliff or rock), high (the band at height) or cover (its point cover).

height.description: A high area's height level; 1 if left out.

sites.description: Building sites, after the base fixture's own.

features.description: Slots each taking a feature fixture, picked by weight.
